name: Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Ph.D.

deadline.value: Fall 2027 final application deadline is July 1, 2027, with an Application Priority Deadline of January 1, 2027; complete applications are reviewed as a group after the priority deadline.
deadline.quote: Complete applications are reviewed for admission by the program as a group after the priority deadline. | Fall 2027 | 09/01/2026 | 01/01/2027 | 07/01/2027

gre_general.value: Neither the 2026-2027 Graduate Catalogue nor the Slate application portal lists a GRE score requirement for Pharmaceutical Chemistry Ph.D. admission (removing an earlier catalog edition's 65th/75th percentile GRE threshold), though no explicit 'GRE not required' statement is printed.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Chemistry (ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Neither the 2026-2027 Graduate Catalogue nor the Slate portal states whether securing a faculty research advisor prior to admission is required (Slate advises contacting the graduate program coordinator before applying to confirm eligibility).

funding.value: Funding is available competitively via dedicated donor-supported Research Assistantships and named doctoral fellowships (Sayed, Maravai LifeSciences, Alcami Corporation Leadership Fellowships), departmental lab Teaching Assistantships, and Graduate School doctoral GRA tuition support (NC Resident + Non-Resident tuition) plus monthly stipend.
funding.quote: Three students have been awarded fellowships in the UNCW Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry’s pharmaceutical chemistry doctoral program. | “We are grateful to the donors for their support in funding dedicated research assistantships that provide advanced training opportunities.”

also.quote: Graduate Research Assistants receive tuition support in addition to their monthly stipend. Students enrolled in master's programs will receive the equivalent of the NC Resident (In-State) portion of their tuition, while students enrolled in doctoral programs will receive both the NC Resident and NC Non-Resident portions of their tuition.
Graduate students also have many opportunities to teach undergraduate labs and mentor younger students in research, including undergraduates and new graduate students.

entry_route.value: Three entry pathways: (1) direct post-M.S. entry (>= 3.0 GPA, 40 post-M.S. credits), (2) B.S.-to-M.S. transition (>= 3.0 GPA, applying to Ph.D. after 2 years with committee approval), or (3) direct B.S.-to-Ph.D. entry (>= 3.5 GPA and evidence of independent research, 60 post-B.S. credits).
entry_route.quote: 1. Students with a M.S in Chemistry or other STEM-related discipline entering directly into the Ph.D. program, or | 2. Students with a B.S. (based on a 4-year program) in Chemistry or other STEM-related discipline entering the MS in Pharmaceutical Chemistry and transitioning into the Ph.D. program, or | 3. Students with a B.S. in Chemistry or other STEM-related discipline entering directly into the Ph.D. program.

notes: DHS STEM-designated Ph.D. (CIP 51.2004 Medicinal and Pharmaceutical Chemistry); cross-listed under biomed because drug discovery and biologics formulation span pharmaceutical chemistry and biomedical research. 2026-2027 Catalogue also states TOEFL >= 79 online / 550 paper or IELTS 6.5/7.0 (Graduate School applies 4.5 on the post-Jan 21, 2026 TOEFL 1-6 scale and exempts India). Department scholarship applications via UNCW common scholarship portal are due March 1.
